description: A singleton helper class wrapping SharedPreferences for easy access to key-value storage in a Flutter app. Provides static methods for reading, writing, and clearing preferences.

classes.name: PreferenceHelper
classes.description: A singleton utility class for managing shared preferences with static methods for initialization and data access.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SharedPreferences instance. Must be called before any get or set operations.

methods.name: writeInt
methods.description: Writes an integer value to preferences for a given key.

methods.name: writeBool
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to preferences for a given key.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string value to preferences for a given key.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer from preferences, defaults to 0.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from preferences, defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean from preferences, defaults to the provided default value.

methods.name: getLoginBool
methods.description: Retrieves a login status boolean, defaults to false.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all preferences, typically used during logout.
